full_prompt_en: A square decorative painted illustration shows a red-haired woman in right-facing profile, enclosed by a round floral frame against a dark patterned ground. Her head and upper shoulder fill the left and center, while the circular border curves around her toward the upper right. Long auburn hair is swept into layered braids and loose waves at the back, each section drawn with thin directional lines and warm copper highlights. Her pale face turns to the right, with a carefully outlined eye, straight nose, softly colored cheek, and slightly parted lips. A brown patterned garment covers her shoulder at the lower left, merging into the warm ornamental palette without drawing attention away from the face. Behind her, cream flowers and pale leaves interlock within the circular halo, their dark stems and fine veins visible against a warm tan field. Beyond the ring, a deeper brown ground carries curling lines, small leaves, and finely worked gold-like accents. The overlapping round border, hair curves, and floral contours repeat one another, giving the image a continuous flowing movement. Surface color is smooth and matte but not flat; fine ink-like outlines and subtle speckling enrich the painted areas. Light is soft and even, brightening her cheek and the pale blossoms while the outer background remains darker and denser. Copper, cream, russet, and umber dominate, with only restrained dark accents. The overall composition balances a calm human silhouette with intricate botanical ornament, producing a warm and quietly formal image.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形装饰性绘画插图描绘一名红发女子的右向侧面，被圆形花卉框围住，外侧是深色带纹背景。她的头与上肩填满左侧和中央，圆框绕着她向右上方弯曲。长长的赤褐发在后方梳成层叠发辫和松卷，每一部分由顺向细线与暖铜色亮部描绘。她的浅色面容转向右侧，有仔细勾画的眼睛、挺直鼻梁、轻着颜色的脸颊和微张嘴唇。棕色花纹衣服盖住左下方肩部，融进温暖装饰色域，却不抢走面部焦点。身后，奶油色花朵与浅色叶片在圆环内互相咬合，深色花茎与细叶脉在暖棕底色前可见。圆环之外，更深的棕色背景带有卷曲线条、小叶片和细作的似金色强调。重叠圆框、发丝曲线和花卉轮廓互相重复，给予画面持续流动的动势。表面颜色平滑哑光，却不平板；似墨的细轮廓和轻微斑点丰富了涂色区域。光线柔和均匀，照亮脸颊和浅色花朵，外部背景则更深、更密。铜色、奶油色、赭红和深褐占主导，只有克制的暗色强调。整体构图以平静的人形剪影平衡繁复植物装饰，形成温暖且安静端正的图像。
style_prompt_en: The image has a refined decorative-illustration finish, combining matte painted color with delicate ink-like contours and dense botanical curves. Copper, russet, cream, tan, and deep umber form a cohesive warm palette, with pale focal areas framed by darker ornament. Thin directional lines and fine veins enrich large smooth planes without disrupting their clarity. Repeated arcs, curling stems, and nested contours create a flowing rhythm; the surrounding detail grows denser toward the edges while the central form stays calm. Light is soft and even, with gentle tonal modeling rather than hard cast shadows. Subtle speckling and restrained surface grain give the image the feel of printed and hand-colored paper. Shallow layered space lets ornament and focal silhouette interlock. The overall effect is elegant, intimate, and richly patterned.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有精致装饰插图质感，把哑光绘色与似墨的细轮廓、密集植物曲线结合。铜色、赭红、奶油色、棕黄与深褐构成统一暖色域，浅色焦点区域由更深的装饰包围。顺向细线和精细脉络丰富大块平滑平面，却不打断其清晰性。重复弧线、卷曲细线与套叠轮廓形成流动节奏；周围细节向画边逐渐变密，中央形体保持安静。光线柔和均匀，以温和色调塑形代替坚硬投影。轻微斑点与克制表面颗粒让图像带有印刷并手工着色纸张的感觉。浅层叠空间使装饰与焦点剪影互相咬合。整体效果优雅、亲密且纹样丰厚。
theme_en: A red-haired woman's profile within a floral circular frame
theme_zh: 花卉圆框中的红发女子侧面
name: Jessica Roux
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
